### Initialization

```{r}
# install.packages(c("tidyverse","tidymodels","discrim","MASS","naivebayes","kknn"))

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(discrim)
library(ISLR2)
library(kableExtra)
library(kknn)
tidymodels_prefer()
```

### Pre-processing

```{r}
data("Auto")
auto <- Auto %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(mpg_hl = if_else(mpg > median(mpg), "High", "Low"),
         mpg_hl = as.factor(mpg_hl)) %>%
  select(-name, -mpg)

# Standardize numeric predictors
auto_rec <- recipe(mpg_hl ~ ., data = auto) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>%
  prep()

auto_std <- bake(auto_rec, new_data = NULL)
```

### Exploratory Visualization

```{r}
auto_long <- auto_std %>%
  pivot_longer(-mpg_hl, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

ggplot(auto_long, aes(x = mpg_hl, y = value, fill = mpg_hl)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Boxplots of Predictors by mpg_hl")
```

### Train/Test Split

```{r}
set.seed(123)
auto_split <- initial_split(auto_std, prop = 0.8, strata = mpg_hl)
auto_train <- training(auto_split)
auto_test <- testing(auto_split)
```

### Model Fit and Assessment

```{r}
library(MASS)
library(naivebayes)

# LDA model
lda_mod <- lda(mpg_hl ~ ., data = auto_train)
lda_preds <- predict(lda_mod, auto_test)$class

# QDA model
qda_mod <- qda(mpg_hl ~ ., data = auto_train)
qda_preds <- predict(qda_mod, auto_test)$class

# Naive Bayes model
nb_mod <- naive_bayes(mpg_hl ~ ., data = auto_train)
nb_preds <- predict(nb_mod, auto_test)

# KNN with tidymodels
knn_spec <- nearest_neighbor(neighbors = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("kknn") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

knn_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(knn_spec) %>%
  add_formula(mpg_hl ~ .)

set.seed(123)
knn_res <- tune_grid(
  knn_wf,
  resamples = vfold_cv(auto_train, v = 5),
  grid = tibble(neighbors = 1:15)
)

knn_best <- select_best(knn_res, metric = "accuracy")

# Final KNN model
final_knn <- finalize_workflow(knn_wf, knn_best) %>%
  fit(data = auto_train)

knn_preds <- predict(final_knn, auto_test)$.pred_class

```

### Model Comparison

```{r}
truth <- auto_test$mpg_hl

results <- tibble(
  model = c("LDA", "QDA", "Naive Bayes", "KNN"),
  accuracy = c(
    mean(lda_preds == truth),
    mean(qda_preds == truth),
    mean(nb_preds == truth),
    mean(knn_preds == truth)
  )
)

results %>%
  arrange(desc(accuracy)) %>%
  kable() %>%
  kable_styling()

```
